hits.title: Creality presents multi-tool creation ecosystem and new hardware range at RAPID + TCT 2026 | VoxelMatters - The heart of additive manufacturing
hits.snippet: voxelmatters.directory/company/creality/) took full advantage of its appearance at RAPID + TCT 2026 in Boston this week to present its broad hardware and software portfolio spanning 3D printing, 3D scanning, laser processing, filament recycling, and cloud-based management. The company’s end-to-end workflow line-up, which connects each stage of the manufacturing process from physical object capture through to finished part production, was in full demo mode as it gave the North American market a hands-on opportunity to see its range – including recent launches – up close. Among the hardware on display was the [SPARKX i7, which was officially launched at CES in Las Vegas at the start of the year](https://www.voxelmatters.com/creality-introduces-sparkx-i7-desktop-3d-printer-with-for-affordable-multicolor-printing/) . The fused filament fabrication (FFF) printer features a quick-swap hotend, a redesigned color-changing mechanism, and a four-color filament system to serve up a desktop configuration that reduces material waste. hits.title: Creality Marks a Decade in 3D Printing with Multiple New Product Launches « Fabbaloo
hits.snippet: Unsurprisingly, Creality took the anniversary opportunity to launch several new products. They announce new products every few months, so an anniversary product announcement is perfectly natural. The new products covered quite a range of functionality. Let’s take a look at what was announced. The new K2 Plus 3D printer [Source: Creality] The big announcement was the new K2 Plus 3D printer, which not only significantly improves performance and quality, but now includes an optional four-spool filament switching attachment, the “Creality Filament System”. We wrote about the [K2 Plus](https://www.fabbaloo.com/news/creality-launches-k2-plus-with-multicolor-capabilities) earlier this week. The Ender-3 V3 3D printer [Source: Creality] Creality surprisingly improved their [just-released Ender-3 V3](https://www.fabbaloo.com/news/creality-launches-ender-3-v3-with-innovative-corexz-system-for-enhanced-speed-and-quality) with unique CoreXZ technology with the Ender-3 V3 Plus.
